subject: Discovery recap + next steps — time-carousel scheduling for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@medicorp.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medicorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps — time-carousel scheduling for technical deep-dive

Hi Ava / Liam —

Thanks again for the 45-minute discovery earlier today. Quick recap of the parts that matter for the deep-dive planning so we can align resources:

- Primary goals: small-batch clinical note summarization, patient PII-safe extraction, and latency targets under 300ms per completion for short prompts.
- Data considerations: workload will be primarily US-hosted EHR snippets. You emphasized SOC 2 evidence and audit logs for inference.
- Success criteria: 1) parity on extraction accuracy vs current rule engine, 2) predictable cost per 1k tokens under $X (we'll tune batching/quantization), 3) a reproducible deployment path for private VPC.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (model choices, network/topology for Private, security touchpoints with your infra team). Because your team spans US/EU/APAC stakeholders, I'd like to propose a simple rotating cadence so the right technical leads can join on alternate weeks without everyone having to work late consistently. Proposed rotation (pick one option):

Option A — US-friendly week (ideal for Medicor engineering):
- Week A: Tue 09:00 PT / Tue 12:00 ET / Tue 17:00 GMT
Option B — EU-friendly week (better for security/compliance folks in CET):
- Week B: Wed 14:00 CET / Wed 05:00 PT / Wed 20:00 SGT
Option C — APAC-friendly week (Asia-APAC attendees):
- Week C: Thu 10:00 SGT / Thu 03:00 CET / Thu 18:00 PT

Rotation proposal: repeat weekly with pattern A -> B -> C so each region gets one meeting at their regular work hours every three weeks. We can make the meetings 60 minutes initially, then extend when we get into architecture walkthroughs.

Can you confirm which option you'd prefer to start with next week (and who from your side should join for that meeting — e.g., sec/compliance, infra, data engineering)? I can put a provisional hold on our calendars and attach a short mutual action plan + discovery notes for context.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20251102.pdf, mutual-action-plan-Medicor.xlsx (both draft).

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Onward — I’ll coordinate slots once you confirm start-week and attendees.
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@medicorp.com>

Karthik —

Thanks, great recap. Quick answers:
- Start with Option B (EU-friendly week) if that works — our security lead (Markus Berg) is in Berlin and it's much easier for him to make CET hours.
- Attendees from Medicor: myself (PM), Liam (data engineering), Markus Berg (security/compliance). Liam will bring one SRE if needed.
- We do need the SOC 2 and audit-log overview in the deep-dive; please include someone from your security or product team.

If you can send an invite for next Wednesday at the proposed slot (14:00 CET), we’ll confirm internally. Also, is 60 minutes sufficient for the first session? We can extend to 90 if the infra folks need more time.

Best,
Ava
